# PlainBTC

> Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news and beginner guides. Official site: https://plainbtc.com

## English

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/): Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news, market recaps, and beginner guides for U.S. readers. Updated November 2026.
- [About PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/about): What PlainBTC is: plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news for beginners, with clear disclosures and no financial advice.
- [Affiliate & referral disclosure](https://plainbtc.com/disclosure): FTC-compliant affiliate disclosure for PlainBTC: Coinbase, Gemini, and River referral links on English pages, Uphold on Spanish and Portuguese pages, and not financial advice.
- [Bitcoin crashes to $55,100, its lowest since 2024, then jumps back above $60,000](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-crashes-to-55100-rebounds-above-60000-nov-2026): Bitcoin hit $55,100 on Kraken at 12:17 a.m. Central time on Saturday, its lowest since September 2024, as about $2.4 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated. By 8:03 a.m. it had bounced to $60,883, up 10.5% from the low.
- [Bitcoin briefly sets a new 2026 low near $57,660 as Strategy shares sink nearly 10%](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-new-2026-low-57661-strategy-shares-sink-nov-2026): Bitcoin hit $57,661 on Kraken at 1:26 p.m. Central time on Friday, a new low for 2026 by less than $100, before bouncing to about $58,800. Strategy shares fell 9.7% to $77.80 and the Nasdaq dropped 5.3%.
- [Bitcoin falls below $59,000 and nears its 2026 low as $1.5 billion in bets are wiped out](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-below-59000-near-2026-low-liquidations-nov-2026): Bitcoin fell to about $58,005 on Kraken around midday Friday, its lowest price since early July and less than 0.5% above the 2026 low of $57,740, as the Nasdaq slid nearly 4% and about $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated.
- [Senate passes DEATH BETS Act to ban prediction market bets on war and death](https://plainbtc.com/articles/senate-passes-death-bets-act-prediction-markets-nov-2026): The Senate passed S. 4035, the DEATH BETS Act from Sens. Adam Schiff and John Curtis, by voice vote on Nov. 19. It would ban CFTC-registered exchanges from listing event contracts tied to war, terrorism, assassination, U.S. military operations or an individual's death. It now goes to the House.
- [BlackRock's bitcoin ETF has its biggest one-day outflow ever: $541.1 million](https://plainbtc.com/articles/blackrock-ibit-record-541-million-outflow-nov-2026): BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) lost a net $541.1 million on Thursday, Nov. 19, beating its previous one-day record of $528.3 million from January. All U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.3 million that day and about $3.47 billion so far in November.
- [SEC says fake advisers and fake crypto apps took $37 million from 1,500 Americans](https://plainbtc.com/articles/sec-fake-crypto-platforms-37-million-whatsapp-nov-2026): On Nov. 19 the SEC sued eight Colorado-based companies, likely run from overseas, over a scheme it says took about $37.4 million from more than 1,500 U.S. investors through fake investment advisers, WhatsApp chats and fake crypto trading platforms.
- [Bitcoin drops below $62,000 to its lowest price since July as stocks slide](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-below-62000-lowest-since-july-etf-outflows-nov-2026): Bitcoin slid to about $61,353 on Kraken on Thursday afternoon, below last weekend's low and its weakest price since July 6, as the Nasdaq and the Dow each fell about 2%. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs have seen net withdrawals of about $2.89 billion in November.
- [Coinbase launches crypto options for users outside the U.S., with U.S. access promised "soon"](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coinbase-crypto-options-non-us-users-deribit-nov-2026): Coinbase launched crypto options for eligible customers in select countries outside the U.S. on Thursday, Nov. 19, using Deribit's liquidity. The contracts cover six assets and settle in USDC. CEO Brian Armstrong said U.S. users will get options "soon" through Coinbase Pro.
- [U.S. launches a Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto scams, with TRM Labs running its tech](https://plainbtc.com/articles/threat-disruption-center-crypto-scams-trm-labs-nov-2026): The Homeland Security Task Force, co-led by DHS and the Justice Department, launched a Threat Disruption Center on Nov. 18 to trace scam money, warn victims sooner and freeze stolen crypto. Blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs is its main private partner.
- [Report: $518 million tied to hackers, including North Korea, flowed through Sky's stablecoin swap](https://plainbtc.com/articles/sky-stablecoin-psm-north-korea-518-million-inca-nov-2026): Crypto risk firm Inca Digital traced $518 million in transactions by wallets tied to hackers and other illicit actors through Sky's stablecoin swap module, including $101.9 million linked to North Korea. It warns that the $2.7 billion USDC reserve could be frozen in one go.
- [Ledger confirms tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is checking two more in Dubai](https://plainbtc.com/articles/ledger-tampered-wallets-berlin-dubai-nov-2026): Ledger says tampered hardware wallets designed to capture recovery phrases have been confirmed in Berlin, and it is investigating two suspected units bought in Dubai. The company calls it the same incident it first disclosed in October.
- [Six senators ask Treasury to protect state-licensed stablecoin issuers before GENIUS Act rules start](https://plainbtc.com/articles/senators-genius-act-state-stablecoin-safe-harbor-nov-2026): Six senators from both parties asked Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to give state-licensed stablecoin issuers the same temporary safe harbor that federally supervised issuers get under a draft GENIUS Act rule, before the law takes effect on Jan. 18, 2027.
- [Fed minutes point to more rate hikes as bitcoin slips below $63,000](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fed-minutes-more-rate-hikes-bitcoin-below-63000-nov-2026): Minutes of the Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting, released Wednesday, show almost all officials expect further rate hikes. Bitcoin fell below $63,000 earlier in the day after Governor Christopher Waller called for a half-point increase in December.
- [Binance says it has an Abu Dhabi court order to recover frozen hack funds as stolen ether moves again](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-abu-dhabi-court-order-frozen-hack-funds-nov-2026): Binance says it secured a court order from Abu Dhabi Global Market to help recover crypto frozen after the record $6.3 billion hack. About $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted, while hack-linked wallets moved 74,880 ether on Tuesday.
- [Russia lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT, capped at 300,000 rubles a year](https://plainbtc.com/articles/russia-retail-investors-bitcoin-ether-usdt-300000-ruble-cap-nov-2026): A Bank of Russia rule that took effect Nov. 17 lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT through licensed intermediaries, up to 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary after a knowledge test. Big brokers T-Bank and VTB are still testing.
- [Judge acquits MIT brothers in $25 million Ethereum trading-bot case, ending the first U.S. criminal MEV prosecution](https://plainbtc.com/articles/mev-brothers-acquitted-25-million-ethereum-bots-nov-2026): A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno over a 2023 trade that took about $25 million from Ethereum trading bots in 12 seconds, ruling prosecutors failed to prove a material lie. It ends the first U.S. criminal case over an MEV exploit.
- [CFTC approves Backpack's blockchain-based derivatives exchange, opening a U.S. path for crypto perpetual futures](https://plainbtc.com/articles/cftc-approves-backpack-blockchain-derivatives-exchange-nov-2026): The CFTC approved Backpack's U.S. derivatives exchange and clearinghouse, which use blockchain to execute and settle trades, after similar approvals for tZERO. Backpack plans 24/7 leveraged crypto perpetual futures for U.S. users. No launch date yet.
- [Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo more than doubled their bitcoin ETF holdings before the selloff, filings show](https://plainbtc.com/articles/goldman-wells-fargo-double-bitcoin-etf-holdings-13f-nov-2026): Quarterly 13F filings show Goldman Sachs held $1.283 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs and Wells Fargo $2.35 billion in BlackRock's IBIT on Sept. 30, more than double June. The numbers predate bitcoin's slide and a $1.91 billion outflow streak.
- [Coinbase opens crypto-backed loans to New York, completing its rollout to all 50 states](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coinbase-borrow-new-york-all-50-states-nov-2026): Coinbase has opened its crypto-backed loans to New York after state approval, so customers in all 50 states can now borrow USDC against bitcoin. New Yorkers get a smaller menu: BTC, ETH and SOL as collateral and variable rates only.
- [Trezor says a shipping partner breach exposed data from about 27,000 hardware wallet orders](https://plainbtc.com/articles/trezor-skladon-shipping-breach-27000-orders-nov-2026): Trezor says hackers broke into its shipping partner Skladon and likely exported names, addresses, phone numbers and order details for about 27,000 hardware wallet orders. Wallet backups and PINs were not involved, but some customers already report scam calls.
- [Hackers used Optimizely to plant crypto-stealing code on 178 big websites, including Ledger](https://plainbtc.com/articles/optimizely-hack-crypto-address-swap-178-sites-nov-2026): An attacker abused a flaw in Optimizely's web-testing tool to plant code on 178 organizations' websites, including Ledger and HSBC. It swapped crypto wallet addresses for the attacker's. About $7,000 was taken before the code was removed.
- [Solana Foundation says it now holds a majority stake in CoinGecko, the crypto price site](https://plainbtc.com/articles/solana-foundation-coingecko-majority-stake-nov-2026): The Solana Foundation says it now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, the price-tracking site with 18 million registered users. No price was disclosed, and CoinGecko says its site and data keep working as usual.
- [Supreme Court won't hear Custodia's case, leaving the Fed free to deny crypto banks a master account](https://plainbtc.com/articles/supreme-court-rejects-custodia-fed-master-account-nov-2026): The Supreme Court declined to hear Custodia Bank's appeal on Monday, ending the Wyoming crypto bank's fight for a Fed master account and confirming the Fed's discretion to refuse one.
- [Solana drops its "mainnet beta" label after six years and calls the network Solana 1.0](https://plainbtc.com/articles/solana-drops-mainnet-beta-solana-1-0-nov-2026): The Solana Foundation retired the "mainnet beta" label on Monday and introduced Solana 1.0. SOL balances and apps stay the same, and users do not need to take any action.

Lighter paused withdrawals, recovered about $5 million and reopened the same day.

A court must approve any final confiscation, and the states still need to consent.

## Bahasa Indonesia

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/id/): Berita Bitcoin dan kripto dengan bahasa sederhana, ringkasan pasar, dan panduan untuk pemula, dengan fokus pada pasar AS. Diperbarui November 2026.
- [Tentang PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/id/about): Apa itu PlainBTC: berita Bitcoin dan kripto dengan bahasa sederhana untuk pemula, dengan keterbukaan yang jelas dan tanpa nasihat keuangan.
- [Keterbukaan afiliasi dan referral](https://plainbtc.com/id/disclosure): Keterbukaan afiliasi PlainBTC sesuai aturan FTC AS: versi bahasa Indonesia tidak memuat tautan referral; bukan nasihat keuangan.

## 日本語

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/ja/): やさしい言葉でお届けするビットコイン・暗号資産ニュース、市況まとめ、初心者向けガイド。米国市場に注目。2026年11月更新。
- [PlainBTCについて](https://plainbtc.com/ja/about): PlainBTCとは：初心者向けにやさしい言葉でビットコインと暗号資産のニュースを届ける、独立した情報サイトです。開示事項を明示し、投資助言は行いません。
- [アフィリエイト・紹介プログラムに関する開示](https://plainbtc.com/ja/disclosure): 米国FTCの基準に沿ったPlainBTCのアフィリエイト開示：日本語版には紹介リンクはありません。投資助言ではありません。
- [ビットコイン、2024年以来の安値5万5100ドルまで急落　その後6万ドル台を回復](https://plainbtc.com/ja/articles/bitcoin-crashes-to-55100-rebounds-above-60000-nov-2026): ビットコインは土曜日の米中部時間午前0時17分、Krakenで5万5100ドルを付け、2024年9月以来の安値となった。この間、約24億ドル相当のレバレッジ取引が強制清算された。午前8時3分には6万883ドルまで戻し、安値から10.5%上昇した。
- [ビットコイン、一時2026年の最安値を更新 5万7660ドル付近　ストラテジー株は10%近く急落](https://plainbtc.com/ja/articles/bitcoin-new-2026-low-57661-strategy-shares-sink-nov-2026): ビットコインは金曜日の米中部時間午後1時26分、Krakenで5万7661ドルを付け、100ドル未満の差で2026年の最安値を更新した後、5万8800ドル付近まで反発した。ストラテジー株は9.7%安の77.80ドル、ナスダックは5.3%下落した。
- [ビットコインが5万9000ドル割れ、2026年安値に迫る　15億ドル規模の賭けが清算](https://plainbtc.com/ja/articles/bitcoin-below-59000-near-2026-low-liquidations-nov-2026): ビットコインは金曜日の正午ごろ、Krakenで約5万8005ドルまで下落し、7月上旬以来の安値をつけた。2026年安値の5万7740ドルとの差は0.5%未満。ナスダックは4%近く下落し、レバレッジをかけたポジション約15億ドルが清算された。
